popup.title: Swamp Monster
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
Swamp monster heard screaming and killing a deer then running off into the forest with green smoke coming off it

popup.title: Bigfoot
popup.description:
Location: [[Hamlet]]
You can hear roars and chase him through the marshes and I came across a wicker man and passed out. Came too in the marshes

popup.title: Redneck Shooting Party
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
Two possibly intoxicated rednecks practising their aim in the middle of nowhere aaaaand.. you can join

popup.title: Plane crash
popup.description:
Location: [[Hamlet]]
Plane crashed with a shipment of drugs Collect it Kill the NPCs Watch out, cops are coming Sell the drugs at Bayn’s warehouse

popup.title: Tree man
popup.description:
Location: [[Hamlet]]
A humanoid-shaped tree surrounded by flowers that release spores; if you stay nearby for too long, a cutscene featuring a creature will be triggered.

popup.title: Store Hostage Rescue
popup.description:
Location: [[Hamlet]]
Jason/Lucia encounters a vehicle with an open trunk and a blood trail leading into a dark building, where 2 men hold a store manager hostage. A unique shotgun can be found be found near the room inside.

popup.title: X-Files Close Encounter
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
An abandoned car sits on the roadside, all doors wide open, emitting strange electronic noises. A trail of discarded clothes leads into the nearby woods. Follow it deeper into the forest to uncover a... weird encounter.

popup.title: Drunkard Asking for Money
popup.description:
Location: [[Key Lento]]
Drunkark going around asking for money

popup.title: Plane Crash: Cocaine and Map
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
This is a crashed plane with a map to deliver the cocaine. 2 bundles of cocaine are located next to the plane

popup.title: Wheelchair Robbery
popup.description: Location: [[Key Lento]]

popup.title: Hijack a Robbery
popup.description:
Location: [[Key Lento]]
A Mother and Daughter will be robbing the liquor store late at night; you can take their filled van off them and get about $1.5K from the back of the van. Van also has extra storage spots

popup.title: Cocaine Yacht
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
If you follow the map from the plane crash in Pellican Valley, you'll find the yacht where the plane was supposed to deliver cocaine. On board, some cash and cocaine to grab

popup.title: Traffic Stop: Drunk Steals Cop Car
popup.description:
Location: [[Key Lento]]
A drunk guy is stopped by two cops and taunts them before hopping in a squad car to take it for a joy ride.

popup.title: Gas Redneck
popup.description:
Location: [[Key Lento]]
A redneck ranting about the deep state is filling up a bathtub in a pickup truck bed with gasoline. He will spray it at the player if they get too close and will usually drive off and explode as he crashes somehow

popup.title: Smuggler Boat Explosion
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
Cocaine Smuggler Boat explodes around here. Easy $1.2k in drugs. Watch out for the sharks. Marker may need some adjusting but it’s roughly correct

popup.title: UFO Event: Suspicious Car
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
Find a car acting suspiciously, inspect the scene.

popup.title: Skunk Apeology 101
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
Speak to the stranger flying the drones.

popup.title: Van Stuck in the Mud
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
Help push the van out of the mud.

popup.title: Missing Wife
popup.description:
Location: [[Key Lento]]
Help Alan Coleman find his wife after a car accident.

popup.title: Cocaine Yacht Shark Attack
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
As you boat through here you hear an explosion: a small boat is on fire after a shark attack. About 4 bags of cocaine float around it.

popup.title: Van Stuck in the Mud
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
Two men are stuck with their van in the mud: help push it out for $200.

popup.title: Witch of the Swamp
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
A woman called the Witch of the Swamp talks about the swamp and asks you to come back a few days later.

popup.title: Hunter Shoots His Friend
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
You hear a gunshot and find two hunters arguing. They ask you to take them to the Hamlet hospital.

popup.title: VR Gamer (house)
popup.description:
Location: [[Key Lento]]
There's a gamer inside the house that's using VR to watch adult content. You get sound notification when you pass the house. There's a couple of other things to do here, a Smash 'n' Grab, unique vehicle in the garage and a Basketball hoop. There's also a safe beside the bed you can break open (one player found $1,100 in it). One player found a Luxury Watch (1 of 37) in the safe.

popup.title: Drug Deal
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
Multiple Cars and a fanboat parked around a stash bag and some gas cans at night. Flares are scattered around. Multiple weapons available and roughly $1.8k in drugs plus some cash.

popup.title: Investigate the Photos
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
(Investigation into the missing persons photos around the area.) The photos you found could be connected to the missing persons posters in Port Gellhorn. Workout where they were taken to find out if there's a connection.

popup.title: Yard Sale (Arthur Morgan hat)
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
There's a yard sale here with an Arthur Morgan hat

popup.title: Kingfishers Ambush on the Road
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
If you have done the robbery with donnie you might get this event where kingfisher ambush you on the highway while blocking the road and shooting at you

popup.title: Alien Witness
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
He says that he saw an alien in this location

popup.title: Hollow Earther's Camp
popup.description: Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]

popup.title: Exploding Smuggler Boat
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
A boat with cocaine explodes and the driver gets eaten by a shark. You can collect 3-4 packages cocaine per $400 each.

popup.title: Garage Band
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
Two dudes on garage

popup.title: Save the Cow
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
A well-dressed show cow escapes. Return her to her owner... or don't.

popup.title: Missing Person Poster
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
A missing person poster from Port Gellhorn, found under the floorboards of the RV with "no lives" spray-painted next to the door.

popup.title: Fortune Teller
popup.description:
Location: [[Key Lento]]
A fortune teller: bad advice for $1, good advice for $5, great advice for $10, a secret for $100 and your future for $1,000.

popup.title: Save the Bear Protest
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
Protesters block the street to free a bear from the back of a van. Convince the driver to let it out: it is a polar bear, which you can shoot and send to Bret.

popup.title: Cool Dog on a Jet Ski
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
Jump off a boat in this area and swim for a moment until you hear a dog barking. Turn around to find a dog on a jet ski: hop on and he takes you to a dog island.

popup.title: Cigarette Trick
popup.description:
Location: [[Key Lento]]
A man shows you a cigarette trick if you give him a cigarette.

popup.title: Escaped Prisoners
popup.description: Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]

popup.title: Trailer Girl (yacht)
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
The woman from the GTA 6 trailer, found on Mattia's yacht.

popup.title: Truck Stuck in the Mud
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
A truck stuck in the mud.

popup.title: Missing Person: Sunken Car
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
In a sunken car at the edge of the lake; only the rusted roof racks show above the water.

popup.title: Missing Person: Pink Car (PRTYGRL)
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
Find the pink car with the plate PRTYGRL, under another car, and open the trunk to find the body.

popup.title: Bear Encounter
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
A tourist confronted by a bear asks you what to do.

popup.title: Kitty Drug Bust
popup.description:
Location: [[Ambrosia]]
Police block the road while they raid a house.

popup.title: Caleb, the Drunk Tractor Driver
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
A drunk tractor driver asks you to drive him to Stacy, his ex-boss.

popup.title: People Jumping in the Water
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
A group asks you to jump into the water with them. You can accept or leave.

popup.title: Cigarette Trick (outdoor bar)
popup.description:
Location: [[Key Lento]]
Give a cigarette to the man with long brown hair and sunglasses and he tries a trick. Seen at night at the outdoor bar.

popup.title: Stolen Tiger in Van
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
Two men with a stuck van. Open the van to find a stolen tiger.

popup.title: Hunter Shoots His Friend
popup.description:
Location: [[Hamlet]]
You hear gunshots and find two hunters: one shot his friend, mistaking him for a deer. Get both into your vehicle and drive them to the nearest hospital before the wounded hunter gets worse.

popup.title: Mandy Filming Her Neighbor
popup.description:
Location: [[Key Lento]]
Meet Mandy in front of a yellow house, next to a small blue cottage. She is secretly filming her naked neighbor.

popup.title: Brofile Pic
popup.description:
Location: [[Key Lento]]
Three guys drinking on top of the Wonder Whale ask you to take a picture of them.

popup.title: Skunk Ape Effigy
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
One of the three skunk ape effigies.

popup.title: Skunk Ape Effigy
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
One of the three skunk ape effigies.

popup.title: Robbed at the ATM
popup.description:
Location: [[Key Lento]]
A man in a floral shirt pulls a gun as you start a deposit and demands all your cash. Hand it over, or refuse and he tries to kill you.

popup.title: Skunk Ape Effigy
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
One of the three skunk ape effigies.

popup.title: Drunk Man at the Rusty Anchor
popup.description:
Location: [[Key Lento]]
A drunk man stumbles outside the Rusty Anchor asking for cash. Give him money for a ride home, or watch him water the plants and drive off drunk in his boat.

popup.title: Dumpster Diver
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
During Chapter 2, a dumpster diver at the motel where Jason and Lucia are staying.

popup.title: A Couple's Dream
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
A couple near the motel's reception entrance, dreaming about their future.

popup.title: Payday Loan Crashout
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
Inside Cash Flow Loans on Gellhorn Avenue, Port Gellhorn: a bald man rages at the ATM and cracks its screen.

popup.title: Iguana Target Practice
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
Three "ecologists" are shooting pumpkins. They challenge you to a $250 contest: shoot the most iguanas after they release them from a cage.

popup.title: Alien Encounter
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
A car sits on the road with all doors open, headlights flashing and a glitching radio. Further along, a bright light in a field: a naked middle-aged woman being beamed up by a tractor beam.

popup.title: Mudslider Mechanic
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
A mechanic fixing his car for the mudslide race asks you to sit in the driver's seat and rev the engine a few times until it is fixed.

popup.title: Fox Furry Cornered by Police
popup.description:
Location: [[Vice City]]
A man in a fox costume cornered by the police.

popup.title: Plane Crash (highway)
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
Driving on the highway you see a small plane trailing black smoke. Follow it to where it crashes on the nearby hill.

popup.title: UFO Believer (Human Sibling)
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
A man standing on the hood of his pickup talks to you about UFOs. May only appear after the nearby UFO encounter.

popup.title: Influencer Livestreaming on Bridge
popup.description:
Location: [[Vice City]]
A man on the bridge is livestreaming.

popup.title: Undercover Cop Torture
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
In this warehouse two men are torturing a tied-up plain-clothes police officer. Listen in, or kill them and untie the cop.

popup.title: Polar Bear Activists
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
Activists trying to free polar bears.

popup.title: Car Accident
popup.description:
Location: [[Vice City]]
A car crash with a bag you can steal.

popup.title: Stash Bust
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
Cops have seized $1,200 of product. Kill them to take the bag and sell it at Dunks.

popup.title: Van Stuck in the Mud
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
A vehicle stuck by the water, the driver asks for help. Open the back door: a tiger jumps out and eats him.

popup.title: The Ritual of Sacrifice
popup.description:
Location: [[Capri]]
Inside the building there is an icon: bring a human corpse to it to start a mini-quest.

popup.title: Shirley, the Neighbor
popup.description:
Location: [[Key Lento]]
Shirley offers two side jobs during the chapter: bring her a bottle of rum, and steal her friend's scooter. In return you may use her car.

popup.title: Merman Encounter
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
A man in a mermaid tail lies on the beach, livestreaming. He allows at least 2 selfies; take more for a surprise.

popup.title: Skunk Ape Effigy
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
A tribal statue made of wood and plants, painted in bright colors.

popup.title: Wounded Hunter
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
A hunter has been shot and needs to be taken to hospital.

popup.title: Junkie Car Theft
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
A junkie asks you to help her steal a car.

popup.title: Warehouse Hostage
popup.description:
Location: [[Vice City]]
Two men are holding a man hostage in the warehouse.

popup.title: Stranded Race Driver
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
A race driver has broken down on the side of the road and asks for a ride to a race before it's too late.

popup.title: Store Hostage Rescue
popup.description:
Location: [[Hamlet]]
A vehicle with an open trunk and a trail of blood leading into the building, where M7 are beating and torturing the manager.

popup.title: Farm Wife Asking for Help
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
A woman in a robe with a flashlight asks you to help her husband, who has had an accident, in their house.

popup.title: Car Accident (truck crash)
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
A Sahara Mirage truck crashes into a car. The driver asks you to lie for him and promises you money if he gets a settlement.

popup.title: Tutsi the Cow
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
Catch Tutsi the cow.

popup.title: Captive Ex-Cop
popup.description:
Location: [[Vice City]]
Free the captured ex-cop.

popup.title: Beefslap
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
A man is standing on top of his broken-down car.

popup.title: Yard Sale (Gary the alligator)
popup.description:
Location: [[Key Lento]]
A lady holds a yard sale with an alligator named Gary.

popup.title: Being Hunted
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
You get tranquilized and wake up in a storage container, where you have to fight for your life.

popup.title: Cop Interrogated by Criminals
popup.description:
Location: [[Watson Bay]]
Criminals are interrogating a cop.

popup.title: Burning Car Collision
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
Two cars have collided and one is burning. The black pickup has a large chest in its bed with cocaine, cash and a Zhang Wu Type 9.

popup.title: Kitty Litter Drug Ring
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
A woman produces Kitty Litter, a synthetic drug. If you pass through, you have to wait until the police finish their operation.

popup.title: AI Ex-CEO
popup.description:
Location: [[Vice Beach]]
May only appear at night.

popup.title: Stuntman
popup.description: Location: [[Vice Beach]]

popup.title: Ghost Woman
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
Drive here at night: your car shuts off and a ghost woman crawls towards you, then appears in your car or as you get out.

popup.title: Ghost Ship (lighthouse)
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
Go to the lighthouse at night: you hear voices and see ghosts that leave clues to a cursed knife in the ocean. With the knife, climb to the top of the lighthouse and face the ocean: the ghost ship appears.

popup.title: Bridge Jumpers
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
A couple of kids jump off the bridge. Challenge them and choose to jump together, and there is more to this encounter.

popup.title: Drunk Tractor Driver
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
A drunk man asks you to help him drive his tractor.

popup.title: Carjacker at Gunpoint
popup.description:
Location: [[Vice Beach]]
A stranger gets into your car, holds a gun to your head and makes you drive.

popup.title: Gasoline Bath
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
A man is filling his bathtub with gasoline.

popup.title: Gang Revenge
popup.description:
Location: [[Hamlet]]
Witness a drive-by shooting: gang retaliation in which a rival member (an M7 recruit) is killed.

popup.title: Skunk Ape Effigy
popup.description: Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]

popup.title: Insurance Fraud
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
After an accident, a man in a burning car: help him and it turns into insurance fraud.

popup.title: Bear Protesters (animal transport)
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
Protesters block a truck carrying a live bear.

popup.title: Crop Dusting Job (McKittrick Farm)
popup.description:
Location: [[Ambrosia]]
A job posting at the Starlet Motel says to call Kyle at McKittrick Farm: he has a crop dusting job.

popup.title: Taser Arrest
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
A man climbs onto a police car, gets tasered and is arrested.

popup.title: Anti-Theft Car
popup.description:
Location: [[Vice City]]
Steal the car and its anti-theft system takes over: it locks the doors and windows and drives you to the police station.

popup.title: Gang Trade
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
Only at night: two gangs meet to trade goods. Ambush them and take the loot (around $1,500).

popup.title: Drunk Man on a Police Car
popup.description:
Location: [[Key Lento]]
A drunk man dances on a police car while officers try to handle him.

popup.title: Paranoid Prepper's Bunker
popup.description:
Location: [[Ambrosia]]
Move the container to reach the bunker, and watch out for mines: a paranoid man sets you more challenges for money.

popup.title: Roadside Forest Fire
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
Off the left side of the highway, a patch of trees is on fire.

popup.title: Clumsy Car Thief
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
A clumsy woman needs your help stealing a car.

popup.title: Botched Robbery
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
Robbers flee the payday loan store, dropping wads of cash on the tarmac as the owner chases them; the cash is left scattered around.

popup.title: Attempted Carjacking
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
At night a muscle car blocks the road and its driver demands money.

popup.title: Kolt & Associates Highway Ambush
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
After completing the chapter 2 mission "Slam Dunk" and gain the ability to raid their drug operations you'll be able to unlock this random encounter as they try to retaliate via an ambush. They will run the car off the road and try to kill you.

popup.title: Former Final Chapter Member Attacked
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
A former Final Chapter member is being beaten and threatened. Help him and untie him to complete it.

popup.title: Newlyweds' House
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
Listen in on a couple who have just got married.

popup.title: Non-Flusher Movement Meeting (Frank's Waffle)
popup.description:
Location: [[Vice City]]
Code: 00-00-02.

popup.title: Kidnapped Cop
popup.description:
Location: [[Watson Bay]]
Two people have tied up a police officer.

popup.title: Dirty Cops (hangar)
popup.description:
Location: [[Watson Bay]]
Inside the hangar at 3 a.m.: a cop tied to a chair is beaten up by two dirty cops.

popup.title: Lady with a Couch
popup.description:
Location: [[Capri]]
Help the woman with her couch and you get kidnapped into the game's take on the Saw movies.

popup.title: Influencer Falls from Overpass
popup.description:
Location: [[Vice City]]
A streamer livestreaming on the edge of the bridge accidentally falls off.

popup.title: Drug Export Threat
popup.description:
Location: [[Key Lento]]
Two men are threatening another man. Question them and they tell you to back off; talk more with the threatened man.

popup.title: Traffic Stop: Golf Clubs
popup.description:
Location: [[Capri]]
A woman is pulled over and her car searched; the police only find golf clubs.

popup.title: Corrupt Cops Rob a Dealer
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
Two corrupt cops beat a drug dealer and steal his cocaine, which opens a possible robbery.

popup.title: Loose Pet Tiger
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
Kingfishers gang members are mauled by a loose tiger. Shoot it, then fight the gang members who arrive.

popup.title: Linda's Coupon Meltdown
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
Linda, the motel receptionist, tries to get a restaurant coupon accepted, is refused and blows up at the staff.

popup.title: Man Tied Up in a Barn
popup.description:
Location: [[Ambrosia]]
A man yells for help, guarded by two thugs. After you save him, there is a shotgun in the back of their truck.

popup.title: Van Stuck in the Mud
popup.description:
Location: [[Watson Bay]]
Help push the stuck van (reward: adrenaline).

popup.title: Skunk Ape Effigy
popup.description: Location: [[Hamlet]]

popup.title: Skunk Ape Effigy
popup.description: Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]

popup.title: Skunk Ape Effigy
popup.description: Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]

popup.title: Non-Flusher Movement QR Code
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
Scan the QR code with WAiNK and answer the Non-Flusher Movement message: it unlocks the side mission to meet a contact at Frank's Waffles in Tequesta, Vice-Dale County.

popup.title: Creepy Neighbour Zach
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
Zach is poking a dead animal with a tree branch; call him out and see what happens.

popup.title: Skunk Ape Effigy
popup.description: Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]

popup.title: Skunk Ape Effigy
popup.description: Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]

popup.title: ATV Rally
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
A crowd watches ATVs jump one of the stunt jumps, and you are invited to take part: a guy challenges you to jump over the concession building for $500.

popup.title: Robbed Naked Man
popup.description: Location: [[Vice Beach]]

popup.title: Car Jacking Lesson
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
Help a woman break into a locked car and steal it.

popup.title: Overpass Vandals (computers)
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
Three rednecks throw computers at cars from the highway overpass. You can scare them off.

popup.title: Delirious Farmer
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
A farmer driving his tractor in circles.

popup.title: Overpass Droppings
popup.description:
Location: [[Capri]]
Three people throw tyres and junk off the overpass. Confront them and they back off quickly.

popup.title: Drive-Through Rant (Pollo Diablo)
popup.description:
Location: [[Hamlet]]
A woman ranting about cheese at the drive-through window.

popup.title: Caveman vs Panther
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
After the caveman deals with a panther, he challenges you to a race.

popup.title: Man vs Bear
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
Tell the man to scare the bear off and he survives and promises to send you money.

popup.title: Sal, Shooting Victim
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
Sal was shot by people trying to rob his wallet. He needs a ride and help with something.

popup.title: Package Delivery
popup.description:
Location: [[Hamlet]]
Deliver 3 packages for a broken-down Sahara driver.

popup.title: Alien Aficionado
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
A man waiting to see something: keep the conversation going.

popup.title: Lady with a Broken Car
popup.description:
Location: [[Key Lento]]
A woman with a damaged car refuses help and gets aggressive. There is a stash in the trunk.

popup.title: Dumpster Man
popup.description:
Location: [[Vice City]]
An attorney asks for pills. If you give him pills, he gives you legal advice.

popup.title: Influencer (antenna)
popup.description:
Location: [[Hamlet]]
At the top of the antenna, an influencer girl takes photos.

popup.title: Drug Boat Crash
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
A drug boat drives in circles and blows up, dropping cocaine.

popup.title: Gasoline Bath
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
A hillbilly fills a tub with gas in the bed of his truck, argues with the gas station clerk, then speeds off.

popup.title: Revenge on Kolt Associates
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
Sal, who shot himself, asks you to get revenge on Booker at Kingpin Bowling.

popup.title: Disgruntled Employee
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
In Huck's Pump N Go you're recognised as one of the couple that robs stores all around Leonida.

popup.title: Paleo Bro
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
A man who wants to fight a panther tries to assert his dominance over it.

popup.title: The Ghost of Rockledge Rd
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
Driving down Rockledge Road at night, a ghostly figure runs across the road.

popup.title: Influencing Gone Fatal
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
Two rednecks film Jason or Lucia making fun of you; when you confront them they pull out their guns.

popup.title: Mistaken Identity ($2,000)
popup.description:
Location: [[Port Gellhorn]]
A man mistakes you for someone else and asks you for $2,000.

popup.title: Polar Bear Protest (freeway)
popup.description:
Location: [[Vice City]]
A group of activists protest on the freeway for the release of a polar bear.

popup.title: Couch Trap
